integrity: The exact Levi, weighted flow, pole escape and supporting-graph calculations establish the SID hypotheses for all stated parameters; the general hypersurface Green continuity theorem then applies. Local KN support geometry is credited to prior general results.
scientific_limitations: Sufficient but not maximal parameter interval; only the specified translated crossing divisor, not arbitrary hypersurface poles. The relevant local KN non-support coefficient window was known prior to the Green continuity construction.
title: An infinite Kohn–Nirenberg tower with continuous hypersurface Green functions
